craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of stated proof — design inference through lacunae; gaps sung as gaps; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). Minimalist answer: bare-showing suffices; somewhere-someone kept indefinite (pakṣadharma-force). Rejected: (a) naming the wise → killed: indefiniteness is the minimalism. Read aloud: MERE-ly SHOW-ing … SOME-one-WISE is-UN-der-STOOD.

lines: Merely showing pervasion with the conscious alone —
by thesis-force, somewhere, someone wise is understood.

reads_against.argmap: What answers the anvaya dilemma? → Reply: bare showing of conscious-only pervasion suffices — by pakṣadharma-force alone, some wise one is grasped. Minimalism against the dilemma.
c1_essence: Bodies bespeak a conscious maker, like pots: the design inference stated through lacunae (vv1-2).
Variety marks wisdom; matter can't arrange; makers proved prove the Lord — answering neither-potter-nor-Lord with conscious-only pervasion shown (vv5-9).
